style: Original contemporary cel-shaded visual novel illustrations. Angular black outlines, warm gold and plum lighting. User supplied style references; no reference text or UI is copied.
format: Each WebP is a 1024 × 1536 three-scene atlas. Original generated PNG converted to WebP quality 88 without resizing or cropping. Runtime displays one scene at a time.

scenes.brief: TOP: rainy London café, Aaron a tan young man with black spiky hair and navy hoodie receives a mysterious notebook from Nia, a black woman with tied braids and mustard jacket. MIDDLE: quiet library, the same two carefully compare an open Bible and two torn pages, warm desk lamp. BOTTOM: sunrise church courtyard, Aaron and Nia share their discoveries with a small diverse circle.

TOP: backstage at a church music rehearsal, Leah a black woman with short natural curls in a burgundy jumper faces Jay a brown-skinned man in a denim jacket beside a microphone. MIDDLE: empty softly lit sanctuary, Leah prays while Jay listens beside a piano. BOTTOM: intimate gathering in the church garden at blue hour, several friends singing without a stage.

Micah: South Asian man, short wavy hair, full beard, mustard raincoat, blue scarf. Mara: East Asian woman, bob, red glasses, turquoise coat. Mr Bennett: elderly silver-bearded white man, red flat cap, grey coat. Station in rain; sheltered woodland footbridge with Bible; riverbank supplies by shuttle bus.

TOP: Caleb, a black man with a flat top and forest green overshirt, proudly displays a shelf of sports trophies to Imani with braids and mustard jacket. MIDDLE: rooftop community garden, Caleb and Imani examine a small seedling with exposed roots beside an open Bible. BOTTOM: mature rooftop garden in golden light, Caleb mentors a new young adult friend.

TOP: Ada, a brown woman with curly shoulder-length hair and teal coat, pauses between a flashy shop window and a modest community centre, Ezra with cream jacket and glasses nearby. MIDDLE: Ada and Ezra share a meal with an older grey-haired black mentor in the centre. BOTTOM: dawn rooftop city panorama, Ada and friends complete a vibrant mural with no lettering.

TOP: Ruth with long natural curls and red coat discovers a lost wallet on a busy London bus beside a black teenage boy Eli with purple hoodie. MIDDLE: community centre office, Ruth and Eli face a pile of volunteer supplies and an older man in a rust cardigan. BOTTOM: cheerful neighbourhood food distribution outside the centre, volunteers reconcile over a crate of groceries.

TOP: Zara, a light brown woman with black bob and blue raincoat, sits outside a hospital in rain with Grace, a black woman in peach cardigan. MIDDLE: night kitchen, Grace listens to Zara across tea and an open Bible, a friend prepares food. BOTTOM: rain-washed park in morning sun, the women walk with a supportive group beneath trees.

TOP: Noah a brown man in orange sweatshirt surrounded by glowing screens and unfinished projects in an evening bedroom, Theo in green jacket and round glasses calls at the open door. MIDDLE: quiet dawn park bench, Noah and Theo plan their day with a notebook and Bible, no writing visible. BOTTOM: warm community hall evening, Noah is present at a table helping a younger friend while his phone lies face down.

TOP: Asher, a black young man in red hoodie, alone on a dusk pedestrian bridge after breaking a friend's camera, Naomi in white coat approaches. MIDDLE: quiet church porch, Asher talks honestly with Isaac and an older grey-haired black mentor. BOTTOM: warm workshop morning, Asher helps the friend repair the camera and they smile cautiously.

TOP: Esther a black woman with short curls and lavender cardigan and Tobi a brown woman in orange coat in a storm-lit apartment, a worrying letter on the table with no visible words. MIDDLE: intimate living room prayer circle with open Bible, the same women and two neighbours speaking together. BOTTOM: bright church courtyard, friends support one another while packing practical supplies, hopeful but no magical resolution.
